name: HELIOS Platform

OPENAI_API_KEY.description: OpenAI API key for the openai provider in config/aihub.json and the codex CLI. Optional: without it those lanes report not-ready instead of failing. Alternative source: Key Vault secret openai-api-key via scripts/bootstrap/load-env-from-keyvault.sh.

ANTHROPIC_API_KEY.description: Anthropic API key for the anthropic provider in config/aihub.json and the claude CLI. Optional. Alternative source: Key Vault secret anthropic-api-key via scripts/bootstrap/load-env-from-keyvault.sh.

GITHUB_MODELS_TOKEN.description: GitHub token with the models:read scope for the github-models provider. Optional: `source scripts/bootstrap/connect-github.sh` exports it from the gh login instead. Alternative source: Key Vault secret github-models-token.

AZURE_KEY_VAULT_URI.description: URI of the Key Vault deployed by infra/main.bicep (printed by scripts/bootstrap/azure-up.sh). Lets load-env-from-keyvault.sh and auto-login.ps1 pull the provider keys after az login, so the three keys above need not be stored as Codespaces secrets at all.

AZURE_OPENAI_ENDPOINT.description: Azure OpenAI account endpoint (https://<account>.openai.azure.com/) for the azure-openai provider in config/aihub.json, which leads the hub's defaultChain. An identifier, not a secret, but declared here so the creation page prompts for it. Printed by scripts/bootstrap/azure-up.sh (infra/main.bicep output); no Key Vault fallback. Optional: without it the azure-openai lane reports not-ready instead of failing.

AZURE_OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional key for the azure-openai provider. Leave it EMPTY (or unset) to authenticate with Entra ID via DefaultAzureCredential after az login --use-device-code; set it only where key auth is required. No Key Vault fallback (config/aihub.json declares no apiKeySecretName for this provider).

postCreateCommand: echo '== [1/4] native C++ spoke (optional; AIHub falls back to managed paths) =='; { command -v cmake >/dev/null 2>&1 && ./scripts/build/build-native.sh || echo 'SKIP: cmake missing or native build failed (non-fatal)'; }; echo '== [2/4] restore + build HELIOS.sln =='; dotnet restore HELIOS.sln || true; dotnet build HELIOS.sln -c Release --no-restore || true; echo '== [3/4] python spoke (ml extras, falling back to dependency-free) =='; python3 -m pip install -e 'src/ai/python[ml]' || python3 -m pip install -e src/ai/python || true; echo '== [4/4] helios-ai on PATH =='; sudo ln -sf "$PWD/src/ai/HELIOS.AIHub.Cli/bin/Release/net10.0/helios-ai" /usr/local/bin/helios-ai || true; { command -v helios-ai >/dev/null 2>&1 && test -x src/ai/HELIOS.AIHub.Cli/bin/Release/net10.0/helios-ai && echo 'helios-ai ready (try: helios-ai status)' || echo 'helios-ai symlinked; run: dotnet build HELIOS.sln -c Release'; }
